english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something being very strong, extreme, or unusually high in degree.

exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 jat6 go3 fung1 ging6 daai6

english.note: Use this colloquial adjective before another adjective to intensify an extreme or strongly negative description.

exampleSentences.english: The royal heir is really happy today.
exampleSentences.traditional: 王位繼承人今日勁開心。
exampleSentences.jyutping: wong4 wai6 gai3 sing4 jan4 gam1 jat6 ging6 hoi1 sam1

english.note: Use 勁 in casual speech for forceful motion or something very severe, such as a headache.

exampleSentences.english: I have a violent headache today.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 go3 tau4 tung3 dak1 hou2 ging6

note: Can also go before another adjective to mean 'very', e.g. 勁大.
